Lvm Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $877.09B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.36% or $2.38 during the last trading session, reaching $172.86. About 21.31 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
